content: Those who have one foot in the canoe and one foot on the shore will soon tumble into the river.
author: Native American Proverbs
explanation: Half-hearted commitment is the fastest recipe for humiliation and failure. You cannot embark on a great adventure while keeping one foot anchored to comfortable security on the bank; as the current pulls the birchbark canoe, your legs are torn apart and you plunge into the rapids. Commit fully.
practicalInsight: Make a full, 100% commitment to your path today. Pull your other foot off the shore.
reflectionPrompt: What important decision in your life are you half-committing to, risking an inevitable fall into the river?
